title: Comparison of D-Wave Quantum Annealing and Gibbs Monte Carlo for Sampling from a Probability Distribution of a Restricted Boltzmann Machine
abstract: arXiv:2508.10228v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: A local-valley (LV) centered approach to assessing the quality of sampling from Restricted Boltzmann Machines (RBMs) was applied to the latest generation of the D-Wave quantum annealer. D-Wave and Gibbs samples from a classically trained RBM were obtained at conditions relevant to the contrastive-divergence-based RBM learning. The samples were compared for the number of the LVs to which they belonged and the energy of the corresponding local minima. No significant (desirable) increase in the number of the LVs has been achieved by decreasing the D-Wave annealing time. At any training epoch, the states sampled by the D-Wave belonged to a somewhat higher number of LVs than in the Gibbs sampling. However, many of those LVs found by the two techniques differed. translated_title: D-Wave量子退火与Gibbs蒙特卡洛在受限玻尔兹曼机概率分布采样中的比较
translated_abstract: 本研究将一种以局部谷（LV）为中心的受限玻尔兹曼机（RBM）采样质量评估方法应用于最新一代的D-Wave量子退火机。在与基于对比散度的RBM学习相关的条件下，从经典训练的RBM中获取了D-Wave和Gibbs采样样本。通过样本所属局部谷的数量以及相应局部极小值的能量对两种采样结果进行了比较。结果表明，减少D-Wave退火时间并未带来局部谷数量的显著（理想的）增加。在每个训练周期中，D-Wave采样的状态所属的局部谷数量略高于Gibbs采样。然而，两种技术找到的许多局部谷并不相同。对于高概率采样状态，两种技术（不利地）表现出较低的互补性和较高的重叠度。尽管如此，许多潜在“重要”的局部极小值……（摘要在此截断）
tldr: 本研究将基于局部谷的采样质量评估方法应用于最新一代D-Wave量子退火机，发现在RBM采样中D-Wave覆盖的局部谷数量略多于Gibbs采样，但两者找到的局部谷差异明显，且在高概率状态上重叠度高、互补性不足。
en_tdlr: This study applies a local-valley-centered sampling quality assessment to the latest D-Wave quantum annealer, showing that D-Wave sampling covers slightly more local valleys than Gibbs sampling for RBMs, but the two methods find substantially different valleys and are less complementary with greater overlap for high-probability states.
